en.joke: My favorite part of remote work is being able to have a full-blown existential crisis between meetings without anyone noticing.
en.explanation: It uses deadpan irony to highlight the isolating nature of remote work and the common struggle with mental well-being in modern corporate life.

people.name: Thích Nhất Hạnh
people.extract: Thích Nhất Hạnh was a Vietnamese Thiền Buddhist monk, peace activist, prolific author, poet, and teacher, who founded the Plum Village Tradition, historically recognized as the main inspiration for engaged Buddhism. Known as the "father of mindfulness", Nhất Hạnh was a major influence on Western practices of Buddhism.

people.name: Nello Pagani
people.bio: Italian motorcycle racer and racing driver (1911–2003)
people.extract: Cirillo Pagani, nicknamed "Nello", was an Italian Grand Prix motorcycle road racer and Formula One driver. He was born in Milan, Lombardy, and died in Bresso.
highlights: Italian Grand Prix motorcycle road racer.

people.name: Sean Patrick Flanery
people.extract: Sean Patrick Flanery is an American actor. He is known for playing Connor MacManus in The Boondock Saints (1999) and its sequel The Boondock Saints II: All Saints Day (2009), Greg Stillson in the television series The Dead Zone, Jeremy "Powder" Reed in Powder (1995), Indiana Jones in the George Lucas television series The Young Indiana Jones Chronicles, as well as Bobby Dagen in Saw 3D (2010). He is also known for his role as Sam Gibson on the CBS soap opera The Young and the Restless in 2011. He starred in Devil's Carnival, a short film which was screened on tour beginning in April 2012.
highlights: Played Connor MacManus in The Boondock Saints.
Starred as Indiana Jones in Young Indiana Jones Chronicles.
Portrayed Greg Stillson in The Dead Zone series.
